merchant/30097.htm.text: Merchant Galladuchi: Luxury goods stores are open again. We have many precious weapons, so please buy a lot. You can now purchase weapons with Adena . If you need any armor or rare miscellaneous goods, ask my wife who is beside me.

Q00043_HelpTheSister/30097-01.html.text: Trader Galladucci: The map traces some very important merchandise! To think it would end up there! Thank you! Did you find it? What? Pet Manager Cooper? Well, OK... Can you take him a message for me?

Q00043_HelpTheSister/30097-03.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Did you deliver my message to Cooper? It is the cycle of Tera!

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-03.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Welcome. We only carry specialty items. I'm sorry, but I can't help you. (Only a character level 3 or above may undertake this quest.)

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-01.htm.text: Trader Galladucci: You have the Traveler's Mark. What can I do for you? I don't work for free, I need something in return. Will you help me?

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-02.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Welcome. We only carry specialty items. I'm sorry, but I can't help you. (Only a character who possesses the Traveler's Mark and who has completed the Step Into the Future quest can undertake this quest.)

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-05.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Take my order document to Magic Trader Gentler at the magic store. Hurry!

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-06.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Did you check the Magic Sword Hilt ? If it has a single scratch, my reputation will be ruined!

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-09.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Take this order document to Jeweler Sandra at her store. Be careful coming back!

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-10.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Keep up the good work! Please give it to me.

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-13.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Priest Dustin holds a high position in the Einhasad Temple of the Town of Giran. Be respectful and courteous. Take him the order document I gave you. Hurry!

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-14.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Thanks, I'm indebted to you. Giran is a big town with a booming trade. You'll meet all types of people, so mind your manners! Now that you've seen it, what do you think?

links.text: "It's great, but I miss my hometown."

Q00173_ToTheIsleOfSouls/30097-01.htm.text: Trader Galladucci: You have the Traveler's Mark, I see. Are you asking me for help? I'll tell you that nothing in this world is free, even if you have connections. You have to work for whatever you want, so forget it if you aren't willing to sweat a little. Still want my help?

links.text: Say that you'll perform the work, whatever it is.

Q00173_ToTheIsleOfSouls/30097-02.htm.text: Trader Galladucci: We only carry very special goods in this shop. I'm afraid that we don't have what you're looking for. (Only Kamael characters who have completed the "New Horizons" quest may undertake this quest.)

Q00173_ToTheIsleOfSouls/30097-04.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Now hurry up and take this order to Magic Trader Gentler at the Magic Shop. Daylight's burning!

Q00173_ToTheIsleOfSouls/30097-05.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Did you check the Magic Sword Hilt carefully? Well, well, thank you. You performed impressively! Giran is a big town, you know, filled with all sorts of activities. You'll also meet all types of people, so mind your manners! Now that you've seen a bit of it, what do you think so …

links.text: "It's great, but I miss my village."

Q00043_HelpTheSister/30097-02.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Ask him to come back when I have more money. I'll treat him! Let's see... Next Tera's period would be good for me! I think I'll have some time around then!

Q00043_HelpTheSister/30097-02a.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Aren't you going to deliver my message to Cooper? Didn't you see the fragment of a Map here? Now I have no reason to call out Cooper, do I? If you find the Map around here, please bring it to me. Hmm, my memory isn't fading, is it?

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-04.htm.text: Trader Galladucci: I like the sense of adventure in Humans. My errand is easy. Bring this order document to Magic Trader Gentler at the magic store and bring the item to me.

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-07.html.text: Trader Galladucci: It's in good shape. Now take this order document to Jeweler Sandra at her store. It's very valuable, so be careful!

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-08.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Lazy Humans! Go back to Magic Trader Gentler for the Magic Sword Hilt . Hurry!

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-11.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Gemstone Powder is very valuable. The Ivory Tower of Oren orders a lot. One last task. Deliver this order document to Priest Dustin at the Einhasad Temple . Be courteous and respectful, he holds a high position. My reputation and business are at stake!

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-12.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Where is the Gemstone Powder? Quit being lazy and get it!

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-15.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Homesick, huh? The roads around Giran are dangerous, be careful on your way home. You can use the Scroll of Escape to return if you choose. Just know that since it's a specialty item, you can use it only once !

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30097-16.html.text: Trader Galladucci: Hurry to Priest Dustin of Einhasad Temple and bring back the necklace! He should be finished by now.
